author: .christn
content:
Hey everyone, ultrasound.money team here. 

I heard there was some concern raised in the last acd regarding lack of testing of the relay path for epbs. 

FYI: We have been running our relay on devnet-8 for a while now, mainly testing the builder facing endpoints with our own dummy / test builder.
In absense of any direct connected proposers we published bids via p2p, to test our win / reveal cycle. 
Our staked builder: https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/builder/2

Next we'd like to test the direct connection path (builder_preferences / getExecutionPayloadBid / beacon_blocks) — so far we've tested it only with kurtosis.

 If anyone's interested in pointing devnet proposers at a real relay endpoint , we'll open up a public endpoint. 
Any takers?

author: potuz
content: Yes definitely! Thanks for this, please open the endpoint I'll point all my stake to it

author: nflaig
content: also happy to point my stake at you guys 😄 but can you take a look at https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/168, I wanna merge that change on lodestar side but we need to align on this on the spec side in case your http endpoints enforce signed auth to be provided

author: stefanbratanov
content: what do clients put for `max_execution_payment` as a default? I made it MAX_EXECUTION_PAYMENT but unsure about it, maybe 0 makes more sense and make it a user responsibility to set it

author: .christn
content: Yes, this works for us. Also approved on github.

author: nflaig
content: default is 0 for us, and to configure anything above 0 a user has to add `--allow-dangerous-trusted-payments` flag, users should be aware of the fact that builder can rug pull them if they set this value above 0

author: .christn
content: Thanks. Will post back here once the endpoint is available. ETA beginning of next week.
